input_law: all ordered source pairs with distinct rational x, first auxiliary x collision at 7 or 11, and identical point reduction at that collision prime
gate: enumerate the frozen local nonsingular order-4/order-6 coefficient witnesses at 7 and 11; pair them in source and local witness order
arithmetic_test: write x1-x2=p*u and y1-y2=p*v; require u nonzero modulo p; compute the unique tangent-compatible a4 residue from a1,a2,a3 and integer x,y,u,v; classify every local gate witness by exact residue equality
null: some one-digit failures may be fixed by changing higher CRT digits while a1,a2,a3 retain their prescribed local residues
decision: if all source pairs have u a unit modulo p, each mismatched collision-prime a4 is impossible under every higher-digit coefficient lift preserving a1,a2,a3 mod p; otherwise retain the unmatched source pairs as open
record: valuation class, local gate counts, all weighted local witness comparisons, compatible and incompatible totals, source and code digests
claim_boundary: local residue compatibility for this source law and relation construction; no assertion about changing the local a1,a2,a3 residues or the input law
